articles.title: Somalia's top court rejects president's term extension amid political crisis
articles.description: The country's first nationwide elections since 1969 are due next year - a timetable now thrown into doubt.

articles.title: Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest
articles.description: Evidence of digging and new buildings are visible in satellite imagery taken in November, satellite images suggest.

articles.title: Nigerian court rules opposition candidate cannot stand in elections
articles.description: The high court has sacked the leadership of the opposition ADC party with only months to go until elections.
